verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a productivity SaaS like Motion, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export feature, no open-format download (CSV/JSON/ICS) and no account-exit path. The REST API for managing projects and tasks is only a developer building block someone could use to build their own export, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
